newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re to acquire INA unit.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re to acquire INA unit.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co said it had signed an agreement to acquire Unione Italiana di Riassicurazione SpA from Italy's Instituto Nazionale delle Assicurazoni SpA (INA).

"The purchase price will be based on the adjusted net asset value of Uniorias as at December 31, 1996 plus a payment for goodwill of 200 billion lira (about $131 million) , mostly for the value of the in-force life business of Uniorias, and is expected to amount to about 500 million Swiss francs," it said in a statement.
Swiss Re said the acquisition of Uniorias, the leading reinsurer in the Italian market and with total gross premiums of 1,504 billion lire in 1995, will be completed in two stages.
Subject to regulatory approvals. Swiss Re will acquire 49 percent of the company early in 1997.

"Subsequently, the business will be restructured in order to separate the reinsurance business from the excess real estate and securities," it said. "These arrangements will also provide for the retrocession of certain exisiting business portfolios of Uniorias to Assitalia. Subject thereto, Swiss Re will acquire the balance of 51 percent of Unioras at the end of 1997."
